<!-- Generated by `make docs-reference` from the code; edit the generator in docs/generator/, not this file. -->

Every failure Stewart reports has a reason. The exception class names the part of Stewart that failed, and
`$e->reason` names the failure: `StoreError::TypeMismatch` belongs to a `StoreException`. Words in braces are
filled in from `$e->context`. [Handling errors](../guides/handling-errors.md) explains how to catch them.

## HaClientError

Thrown as `HaClientException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ClosedLocally` | The connection was closed locally while {phase}. |  |
| `ConnectTimedOut` | Connecting to Home Assistant at {url} timed out after {timeout}. Check home_assistant.url. | Test the URL from the container: `make sh`, then `wget -qO- http://your-host:8123`. |
| `ConnectFailed` | Could not connect to Home Assistant at {url}: {cause} | Check `STEWART_HOME_ASSISTANT__URL`; inside the container `localhost` is the container, so use the host name, IP or `host.docker.internal`. |
| `NotConnected` | Not connected to Home Assistant. |  |
| `SendFailed` | Failed to send {command}: {cause} |  |
| `ClosedDuringAuthentication` | Home Assistant closed the connection during authentication. | Check `STEWART_HOME_ASSISTANT__TOKEN`, then the Home Assistant log from the same moment. |
| `ConnectionDropped` | The connection to Home Assistant was lost ({detail}). |  |
| `MessageTooLarge` | Home Assistant sent a message over the size limit, so the connection was dropped. Raise home_assistant.message_size_limit or home_assistant.frame_size_limit. |  |
| `ProtocolViolation` | Home Assistant sent {detail}. |  |
| `CommandTimedOut` | Home Assistant did not answer {command} within {timeout}. |  |
| `CommandRejected` | {command} failed: {detail} |  |
| `CommandUnauthorized` | {command} failed: {detail} |  |
| `CommandUnencodable` | {command} could not be encoded: {cause} |  |
| `UnexpectedGreeting` | Expected auth_required from Home Assistant, got "{receivedType}". |  |
| `TokenRejected` | Home Assistant rejected the access token: {reason}. Check STEWART_HOME_ASSISTANT__TOKEN. | Create a long-lived access token on your Home Assistant profile, under Security, as an administrator. |
| `AdministratorRequired` | Home Assistant refused the event subscription; the access token must belong to an administrator. Update STEWART_HOME_ASSISTANT__TOKEN. | Create the token from a Home Assistant administrator. |
| `EventBacklogExceeded` | Event handlers are more than {limit} events behind; dropping the connection. |  |
| `EventQueueReentered` | An event callback cannot wait for the event queue it is being delivered by. |  |
| `UrlInvalid` | "{url}" is not a Home Assistant URL; use http://, https://, ws:// or wss:// and a host. | For example `ws://homeassistant.local:8123/api/websocket` in `STEWART_HOME_ASSISTANT__URL`. |
| `ComponentInstanceInvalid` | "{instance}" is not an instance name; use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, up to 64 characters. |  |

## CodegenError

Thrown as `CodegenException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SnapshotUnreadable` | Snapshot {path} cannot be read. |  |
| `SnapshotNotJson` | Snapshot {path} is not valid JSON: {reason} |  |
| `NotASnapshot` | {path} is not a snapshot; write one with `stewart generate --snapshot-out`. |  |
| `OutputDirectoryNotCreatable` | Cannot create output directory {path}. |  |
| `FileNotWritable` | Cannot write {path}. |  |
| `FileNotDeletable` | Cannot delete {path}. |  |
| `UnmarkedFileInTheWay` | {path} was not written by stewart generate; move it out of the output directory. |  |
| `ShrinkRefused` | Generating would delete {deleted} of {existing} generated files; run `make generate ARGS=--allow-shrink` if that is intended. |  |
| `HomeAssistantNotRunning` | Home Assistant is {state}; run `stewart generate` again once it has started. |  |

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Rejected` | {reason} |  |

## EventFireError

Thrown as `EventFireException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TypeInvalid` | An event type must be 1 to 64 characters, got "{eventType}". |  |
| `DataInvalid` | Data of event {eventType} at {path} is {actualType}; expected null, a finite scalar or an array of those. |  |
| `DataNotKeyed` | Data of event {eventType} must be keyed by name, got a list. |  |
| `Rejected` | Event {eventType} was rejected by Home Assistant: {detail} |  |
| `Unreachable` | Event {eventType} could not reach Home Assistant: {detail} |  |
| `TimedOut` | Event {eventType} timed out: {detail} |  |
| `Overloaded` | Event {eventType} was refused: {detail} |  |

## ExposureError

Thrown as `ExposureException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ComponentMissing` | Entity {key} cannot be exposed because the stewart Home Assistant integration is not installed; see `stewart status`. | Install the Stewart integration in Home Assistant and restart it. |
| `ProtocolMismatch` | Entity {key} cannot be exposed because the stewart Home Assistant integration speaks another protocol; see `stewart status`. | Update Stewart or the integration so both have the same version. |
| `ComponentRefused` | Entity {key} cannot be exposed because Home Assistant refused the stewart integration session; see `stewart status`. |  |
| `OutsideApp` | Entity {key} cannot be exposed outside an app, because its unique ID needs an app ID. |  |
| `KeyInvalid` | Exposed entity key "{key}" is invalid; use up to {limit} lowercase letters, digits and "_", starting with a letter. |  |
| `KeyTaken` | App {appId} already exposes an entity with key {key}. |  |
| `ConfigInvalid` | Home Assistant cannot use this entity configuration: {detail} |  |
| `StateInvalid` | Home Assistant cannot use this entity state: {detail} |  |
| `Removed` | Exposed entity {key} was removed; expose it again to use it. |  |
| `Unreachable` | Could not reach the broker for exposed entity {key}: {detail} |  |
| `TimedOut` | The broker did not answer for exposed entity {key} within {timeout}. |  |

Thrown as `IdentifierException`.

| `EntityIdInvalid` | Entity ID "{entityId}" is invalid; expected "<domain>.<object_id>" in lowercase letters, digits and "_". |  |

## ServiceCallError

Thrown as `ServiceCallException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Rejected` | {domain}.{service} was rejected by Home Assistant: {detail} | Try the same call under Developer tools → Actions in Home Assistant. |
| `Unreachable` | {domain}.{service} could not reach Home Assistant: {detail} |  |
| `TimedOut` | {domain}.{service} timed out: {detail} |  |

## StateError

Thrown as `StateException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EntityNotFound` | Entity "{entityId}" does not exist in Home Assistant. |  |
| `StateChangedViaEvents` | The "{eventType}" event is only delivered through watchStateChanges(), not watchEvents(). |  |
| `ThresholdHysteresisNegative` | The hysteresis of {usage}() is {hysteresis}; it must be zero or more. |  |
| `ThresholdNotFinite` | The threshold of {usage}() is {threshold}; it must be a finite number. |  |
| `TransitionRuleConflict` | whenChangedTo() takes either from: or fromAnyState:, not both. |  |

## StoreError

Thrown as `StoreException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `KeyInvalid` | Store key "{key}" is invalid; expected a letter or digit, then up to 127 letters, digits, ".", "_", ":" or "-". |  |
| `ValueNotEncodable` | The value for key "{key}" is not JSON-encodable: {cause} |  |
| `ValueNotAMap` | {class}::toStorage() returned a list for key "{key}"; expected a map of named fields. |  |
| `NotConfigured` | Persistence is not configured; set persistence.url in stewart.yaml or STEWART_PERSISTENCE__URL in .env. | Set `STEWART_PERSISTENCE__URL`. |
| `Unreachable` | The store at {target} is unreachable: {detail} | Check `STEWART_PERSISTENCE__URL` and that Valkey runs: `docker compose ps valkey`. |
| `Refused` | The store at {target} refused the operation: {detail} |  |
| `TimedOut` | The store at {target} did not answer within {timeout}. | Check that Valkey is not overloaded; `docker compose logs valkey` shows its state. |
| `RecentlyFailed` | The store at {target} failed moments ago and is not being retried yet: {detail} |  |
| `TypeMismatch` | Key "{key}" holds {actual}, not {expected}. | Read the key with the type it was written with, or delete it. |
| `NotIncrementable` | Key "{key}" cannot be incremented: {detail} |  |
| `ValueNotIncrementable` | The stored value cannot be incremented: {detail} |  |
| `ValueMalformed` | Key "{key}" does not hold valid JSON: {cause} |  |
| `ValueRejected` | {class}::fromStorage() rejected the value of key "{key}" (handle the old shape or delete the key): {cause} | Make `fromStorage()` accept the stored shape, or delete the key. |

## AppError

Thrown as `AppException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DuplicateId` | Automations {firstClass} and {secondClass} both use ID "{appId}"; "-" and "_" count as the same character. |  |
| `DirectoryNotAutoloadable` | {directory} is not covered by a PSR-4 autoload rule. Add it to "autoload" in composer.json and run `make install`. |  |
| `NotAnApp` | {className} has #[Automation] but does not implement {appInterface}. |  |
| `NotInstantiable` | {className} has #[Automation] but cannot be instantiated. |  |
| `IdInvalid` | {className}: automation ID "{appId}" is invalid; use lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "_", starting with a letter. |  |
| `InitializeTimedOut` | {appId} initialize() did not return within {timeout}. Raise supervision.initialize_timeout if needed. |  |
| `Unknown` | No automation with ID "{appId}". |  |
| `Disabled` | Automation "{appId}" is not loaded because apps.{appId}.enabled is false. |  |

## BrokerError

Thrown as `BrokerException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NoWorkersStarted` | None of {workers} workers could be started. | The log lines above name why each worker failed; `stewart doctor` checks the PHP setup. |
| `WorkerSpawnTimedOut` | Worker {worker} did not connect within {timeout}. |  |

## ConfigurationError

Thrown as `ConfigurationException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SchemaViolation` | {cause} |  |
| `ConfigFileMissing` | Config file {path} not found. | Fix the `--config` path; without the option, Stewart reads `stewart.yaml` in the project root, or the environment alone. |
| `ConfigFileUnparsable` | Could not parse {path}: {cause} | Fix the YAML where the cause points, then check the result with `make config`. |
| `ConfigFileNotAMap` | {path} holds {actualType}; expected a map of settings. |  |
| `ValueInvalid` | "{value}" is not {expected}. |  |
| `KeyInvalid` | {path} must be {expected}. |  |
| `KeyParseFailed` | {path} is invalid: {cause} |  |
| `DurationTooShort` | {path} is {value}; expected at least {minimum}. |  |
| `DurationTooLong` | {path} is {value}; expected at most {maximum}. |  |
| `MaxDelayBelowInitialDelay` | {path} is {value}; expected at least {initialDelayPath} ({initialDelay}). |  |
| `RestartWindowTooShort` | supervision.restart_window is {window}, but the backoff for restart_attempts ({attempts}) adds up to {backoffTotal}, so a crash-looping worker is never quarantined. |  |
| `HomeAssistantMissing` | home_assistant is not configured. Set STEWART_HOME_ASSISTANT__URL and STEWART_HOME_ASSISTANT__TOKEN. | `make env` creates `.env` with both keys to fill in. |
| `PlaceholderUnset` | {setting} refers to ${{variable}}, which is not set. Set it or add a default: ${{variable}:-value}. | Add the variable to `.env`. |
| `ControlTokenMissing` | control.token is required while control.listen is set; set STEWART_CONTROL__TOKEN or set control.listen to "off". | `make env` writes a fresh token into a new `.env`; for an older one, add `STEWART_CONTROL__TOKEN=` followed by `openssl rand -hex 16`. |
| `AdminTokenMissing` | http.admin.token is required while http.admin.listen is set; set STEWART_HTTP__ADMIN__TOKEN or set http.admin.listen to "off". | Create one with `openssl rand -hex 16` and set it as `STEWART_HTTP__ADMIN__TOKEN`. |
| `WorkerIndexOutOfRange` | App "{appId}" is pinned to worker {worker}, but the highest worker index is {highestIndex}. |  |
| `AppSelectionUnknown` | --only names app "{appId}", but no automation has that ID. |  |
| `EnvironmentVariableUnknown` | {variable} is not a Stewart setting; run `stewart config:reference` for all options. | Fix the variable name; keys are joined by two underscores. |
| `EnvironmentVariableTooDeep` | {variable} is deeper than the configuration; {valuePath} is a value, not a section. |  |
| `EnvironmentVariableNamesSection` | {variable} names a section; set the keys under it, such as {variable}{separator}KEY. |  |
| `EnvironmentValueInvalid` | {variable} is "{raw}"; expected {expected}. | Fix the value in `.env`; `make config-reference` lists the type of every setting. |
| `EnvironmentValueUnparsable` | {variable} is not a valid inline list or map: {cause} |  |
| `EnvironmentVariableConflict` | {variable} and {otherVariable} both set {valuePath}; keep one. |  |
| `EnvironmentSecretFileUnreadable` | {variable} points to {path}, which cannot be read. |  |
| `MqttPackageMissing` | mqtt.url is set, but the MQTT client is not installed; run `composer require stewart-php/mqtt`. | Or unset `STEWART_MQTT__URL` if no app uses MQTT. |

## ContainerError

Thrown as `ContainerException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ServiceTypeMismatch` | Service "{serviceId}" is {actualType}; expected {expectedType}. |  |
| `BuildFailed` | Worker {workerId} failed to build its container: {cause} |  |
| `AppInServicesFile` | services.php defines "{serviceId}" as automation {class}. Configure it in stewart.yaml instead. |  |
| `PeerStoreWritable` | {class}::__construct() takes ${parameter} with #[PeerStore] as Store; type it ReadableStore. |  |
| `PeerStoreAppIdInvalid` | {class}::__construct() takes ${parameter} with #[PeerStore]: {cause} |  |
| `MessageHandlerDuplicated` | {firstHandler} and {secondHandler} both handle {messageClass}. |  |
| `AppOptionInvalid` | Option "{option}" of app "{appId}" is "{value}", which is not a valid {expectedType}. |  |
| `AppOptionUnknown` | App "{appId}" sets option "{option}", which matches no parameter of {class}::__construct(). | Rename the option in `stewart.yaml` to match a constructor parameter. |
| `AppOptionMissing` | App "{appId}" needs option "{option}"; {class}::__construct() takes ${option} with no default. | Set the option, or give the parameter a default. |
| `AppOptionAmbiguous` | App "{appId}" sets option "{option}", which matches parameters {parameters} of {class}::__construct(); use the exact name. |  |
| `AppOptionRepeated` | App "{appId}" sets ${parameter} of {class}::__construct() twice, as options "{firstOption}" and "{secondOption}". |  |
| `AppBuildFailed` | App "{appId}" cannot be built: {cause} |  |
| `AppClassMissing` | App "{appId}" names class {class}, which cannot be loaded. |  |
| `ServicesFileMissing` | Services file {path} no longer exists. |  |

## ControlError

Thrown as `ControlException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SocketInUse` | Another daemon is already listening on {address}. Stop it or change control.listen. |  |
| `SocketUnremovable` | Could not remove the stale control socket {path}. |  |
| `SocketDirectoryNotCreatable` | Could not create control socket directory {directory}. |  |
| `SocketPathNotASocket` | The control socket path {path} exists and is not a socket. |  |
| `FrameNotJson` | Frame is not JSON: {cause} |  |
| `FrameNotAnObject` | Frame is {actualType}; expected a JSON object. |  |
| `FrameUnencodable` | Could not encode {frameClass}: {cause} |  |
| `FrameClassUnknown` | Unknown frame {frameClass}. |  |
| `FrameUndecodable` | Could not decode the "{frameType}" control frame: {cause} |  |
| `ConfigUnavailable` | Could not read control.listen and control.token (pass --address and --token): {cause} |  |
| `ControlDisabled` | The configuration sets control.listen to off; pass --address. | Pass the daemon's address, such as `--address tcp://homeassistant.local:7333`, or run `make status` next to the daemon. |
| `TokenMissing` | No control token; set STEWART_CONTROL__TOKEN or pass --token. |  |
| `ConnectionRejected` | The broker refused the connection: {reason} | For a wrong token, use the daemon's `STEWART_CONTROL__TOKEN`; `make status` runs next to the daemon with its `.env`. |
| `UnexpectedGreeting` | The broker sent {frameClass} instead of a welcome. |  |
| `ProtocolMismatch` | Broker speaks control protocol {brokerProtocol}, this client {clientProtocol}. | Use the `stewart` of the running daemon's version, for example `make status`, which runs in its container. |
| `BrokerHungUp` | The broker hung up before the session ended. |  |
| `UnexpectedFrame` | The broker sent {frameClass} instead of {expectedFrameClass}. |  |
| `RequestTimedOut` | The broker did not answer within {timeout}. |  |
| `RequestUnexpected` | The control session expects a request, not {frameClass}. |  |
| `RequestFailed` | The broker refused the request: {message} |  |
| `RequestUnanswerable` | The broker could not answer the request: {cause} |  |

| `SchemeUnsupported` | No installed store backend handles "{scheme}://"; installed schemes: {supported}. |  |
| `UnknownPeerApp` | No automation has ID "{appId}", so its store cannot be opened. |  |
| `PrefixInvalid` | Store prefix "{prefix}" is invalid; expected a letter or digit, then up to 63 letters, digits, ".", "_" or "-". |  |

## JsonShapeError

Thrown as `JsonShapeException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `WrongType` | "{key}" is {actualType}; expected {expected}. |  |
| `Missing` | "{key}" is missing; expected {expected}. |  |
| `UnexpectedValue` | "{key}" is {value}; expected {expected}. |  |
| `InstantInvalid` | "{key}" is invalid: {cause} |  |
| `ObjectRefused` | "{key}" was refused: {cause} |  |

## HarnessError

Thrown as `HarnessException`.

| Reason | Message | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AlreadyStarted` | The harness already runs {class}; use one harness per app. |  |
| `AutomationMissing` | {class} has no #[Automation] attribute, so it is not an app. |  |
| `NotStarted` | No app is running; call startApp() first. |  |
| `OptionMissing` | {class}::__construct() needs option "{option}"; pass it to startApp(). |  |
| `OptionUnknown` | Option "{option}" matches no parameter of {class}::__construct(). |  |
| `ParameterUnresolvable` | {class}::__construct() takes ${parameter} as {type}, which the harness has no fake for; pass one with provideService(). |  |
